_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: E leai ni kata i le taimi nei.
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Pela Tasi vs Dealer

📖 FAAMATALAGA O LE TAALO:
• E amata ou ma {start_chips} sipuni
• Tupe o kaarteni 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• E taalo ou i le dealer (fale)
• Ia taalo uma raipega e pei o le faiga a le Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ou te faia ai pepa ANTE ma BLIND, maua 2 kaarteni hole, filifili i pepa faavalo PLAY i vaitaimi o le taalo, ona mae’a lea faia le faatalofa o kaarteni komuniti ma faatusatusa le lima kaarteni sili lea ou te maua i le lima kaarteni sili a le dealer. Ou te manaomia le faaleleia o lau faatauaina (pe a fai ou se kaarteni sili), faapea le puipuia o ou faatauaina (pe a fai ou se kaarteni leaga).
• Taalo e mae’a pe a e oo i le 0 sipuni pe lalo ifo i le amataina o le raipega (FALE) pe e maua 1000 raipega ma sipuni (TAGI)

💰 FAIGA O PEPA:
• ANTE: Pepa faamau ${ante} i uma raipega
• BLIND: Pepa faamau ${ante} i uma raipega
• PLAY: Pepa faavalo i le vaitaimi o le taalo. I le taalo, e mafai ona e filifili ai se tasi o nei: (${ante4} pe a fai i le PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} pe a fai i le FLOP, pe ${ante} pe a fai i le RIVER. E mafai fo’i ona e tuusao i le RIVER, faapea le faamauina o le lima, ma le faia o pepa.

🎴 TOGI KAARTENI:
• E maua e oe 2 kaarteni faalogo (kaarteni hole a oe)
• Dealer maua 2 kaarteni faalogo (puupuu mai ia te oe)
• 5 kaarteni komuniti e togia faalogo i le amata
• Kaarteni komuniti e faatalofa atu i vaitaimi o le taalo

🏆 FAAMAUINA O LE DEALER:
• Dealer e manaomia se PAIR (2 kaarteni o le tulaga e tasi) e faamauina, e aofia ai le 2 kaarteni i lona lima ma le 5 kaarteni komuniti.
• Faamauina o le dealer e aafia ai le faaiuga o le pepa, e pei o le a faamatala mai.

🎮 VAITAIMI O LE TAALO & GAOIOIGA:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Gaoioiga: [4x] (${ante4}) pe [check]
  • [4x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${ante4}, faatalofa atu le muamua 3 kaarteni komuniti
  • [check]: Aisea pepa faavalo, faatalofa atu le muamua 3 kaarteni komuniti

📋 FLOP:
  • Pe a faia le pepa 4x: O le [skip] e manaomia (faatalofa atu le 2 kaarteni komuniti mulimuli)
  • Pe a leai se pepa 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) pe [check]
  • [2x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${ante2}, faatalofa atu le 2 kaarteni komuniti mulimuli
  • [check]: Aisea pepa faavalo, faatalofa atu le 2 kaarteni komuniti mulimuli

📋 RIVER:
  • Pe a faia le pepa 4x pe 2x: O le [skip] e manaomia (faatalofa atu i le faaiuga)
  • Pe a leai se pepa PLAY muamua: [1x] (${ante}) pe [fold]
  • [1x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${ante}, faatalofa atu i le faaiuga
  • [fold]: Tuusao le lima, faamauina le ANTE ma le BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • O le a faatalofa atu uma kaarteni ma faatusatusa
  • Le 5 kaarteni sili lea e maua mai i le 7 kaarteni (2 hole + 5 komuniti)
  • Pepa e faaiuina e pei o le faiga o le faatauaina

💎 PEPA O LE FAATAUAINA:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer e leai se faamauina: PUSH (pepa return)
  • Dealer faamauina ma e tagi oe: 1:1 faatauaina (pepa + faatauaina)
  • Dealer faamauina ma e fale oe: Pepa faamauina
  • Tie: PUSH (pepa return)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • E leai se aafia i le faamauina o le dealer
  • E tagi oe: Pepa return ma le faatauaina faapitoa e pei o le malosi o le lima
  • E fale oe: Pepa faamauina
  • Tie: PUSH (pepa return)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Aisea faatauaina faapitoa

📊 PLAY BET:
  • E leai se aafia i le faamauina o le dealer
  • Faatusatusa faalogo: Le lima sili lea a oe i le lima sili a le dealer
  • E tagi oe: 1:1 faatauaina (pepa + faatauaina)
  • E fale oe: Pepa faamauina
  • Tie: PUSH (pepa return)

🎯 FAIGA O LE LIMA (Sili i le Leaga):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 o le suit e tasi
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kaarteni faatasi o le suit e tasi
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kaarteni o le tulaga e tasi
  4. Full House: 3 o le tulaga e tasi + 2 o le tulaga e tasi
  5. Flush: 5 kaarteni o le suit e tasi
  6. Straight: 5 kaarteni faatasi
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kaarteni o le tulaga e tasi
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs o tulaga eseese
  9. One Pair: 2 kaarteni o le tulaga e tasi
  10. High Card: Le kaarteni sili e tagi

⌨️  FAIGA O GAOIOIGA:
• [4x] pe [play bet 4x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*4}}
• [2x] pe [play bet 2x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*2}}
• [1x] pe [play bet 1x]: Faia le pepa PLAY ${{self.ante_amount*1}}
• [check] pe [c]: Check (aisea pepa faavalo)
• [fold] pe [f]: Fold (tuusao le lima)
• [skip] pe [s]: Skip to next phase (pe a leai se gaoioiga manaomia)

💡 FAAMATALAGA O LE FAIGA:
• Kaarteni amata sili (pairs, high cards) e manaomia le pepa 4x
• Faalogo i le faamauina o le dealer - kaarteni leaga e mafai ona push pe a leai se faamauina o le dealer
• BLIND bet e mafai ona faatauaina tele ma kaarteni sili (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Faalogo i lau sipuni! Pe a oo i le 0 sipuni pe lalo ifo i le amataina o le raipega, e fale oe.

⚠️  FAAMATALAGA TAITASI:
• ANTE ma BLIND bets e faamau i uma raipega
• PLAY bets e faavalo ma faiga
• Faamauina le gaoioiga sahi, ma le tasi gaoioiga i le taimi.
